login.tagline: Project memory for architecture and construction.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
login.title: Sign in
login.emailOnly: Sign in with your account's e-mail and password.

google.startError: Could not start Google sign-in. Try again.

errors.invalid_state: This sign-in link is invalid or has already been used. Start again.
errors.invalid_token: Google's answer could not be verified. Start again.
errors.email_unverified: Your Google email is not verified. Verify it with Google or use another account.
errors.exchange_failed: Google did not complete the sign-in. Start again.
errors.unknown_email: There is no Promem account for this Google email. Ask your organization admin for an invitation.
errors.account_disabled: The account for this email is disabled. Contact your organization admin.
errors.email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to another email. Continue with the Google account of the invited email.
errors.invitation_gone: This invitation has already been used, revoked or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.browser_mismatch: This sign-in was started in another browser or tab. Start again here.
errors.google_account_mismatch: This Google account is not the one linked to your Promem account. Sign in with the Google account you used before, or with your password.
errors.google_account_in_use: This Google account is already linked to another Promem account.
errors.operator_cannot_join: The platform operator account cannot join organizations.
errors.already_member: You are already a member of this organization. Log in to open the project.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
changePassword.hint: At least {{n}} characters, different from the current one.
changePassword.success: Password changed. Use the new password next time you log in.

errors.mismatch: The confirmation does not match the new password.
errors.password_too_short: The new password needs at least {{n}} characters.
errors.password_too_long: The new password is too long.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.no_password_set: Your account signs in with Google and has no password. Keep signing in with Google.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Could not change the password. Please try again.
